free_tier.stated: CNY 50 per month for the US dual-ISP residential-IP plan: 1 core, 1 GB RAM, 20 GB SSD, 1 TB a month, 1 Gbps, one IPv4. Germany and the United Kingdom are CNY 60 a month for the same shape, the Philippines is CNY 80 a month for 1 GB, 1 core, 15 GB and 1 TB, Korea CNY 80 a month for 1 GB, 1 core, 20 GB and 1 TB at 200 Mbps, and the 2 GB rows start at CNY 160. The offer states no real-name registration and no ICP filing are required, and Alipay is accepted.

egress.terms: 1 TB a month on every row, 1 Gbps on the US, German and UK rows, 200 Mbps on Korea; no overage price stated
